subject.title: feat(mac): Quick Chat — global-shortcut floating composer for the main session

question: Should Quick Chat automatically claim Option-Space for users without a saved chord, despite the dependency's recommendation that public apps let users choose their shortcut?
rationale: The delivery defect is mechanically repairable, but the default global-shortcut conflict policy requires explicit macOS product ownership.

options.title: Use opt-in shortcut
options.body: Ship the menu item and Settings recorder without an initial chord, allowing each user to choose a conflict-free shortcut.

options.title: Retain Option-Space
options.body: Accept Option-Space as a deliberate macOS default and clearly document how users can replace or clear it.

recommendation.title: Use opt-in shortcut
recommendation.body: Ship the menu item and Settings recorder without an initial chord, allowing each user to choose a conflict-free shortcut.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature owner and repository lead is best positioned to decide the macOS shortcut policy. citeturn22view0
